sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Computer Itself, prediction 14, printed p. 22

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: More than half of generated text comes from continuous-speech dictation.
reference.rationale: The author’s own retrospective acknowledges that dictation had not become the majority input method in 2009. Dictation is effective and widely available, but typing and non-dictated text remain central. The majority claim is still not supported; this assessment is an inference, not a global text-volume census.
